title: Customer Service Management
overview: Exceptional customer service is often the key differentiator between companies. While competing products can be similar and easily replicated, outstanding customer service requires a comprehensive, organization-wide effort. This effort must be driven from the top and integrated into every aspect of the organizational culture. By building a customer-centric organization, companies can become formidable competitors with models that are difficult to imitate. This course explores what it takes to create such an organization.
audience: This course is designed for executives, managers, and decision-makers who aim to enhance performance by elevating customer satisfaction levels. It is also ideal for customer service managers and supervisors seeking advanced tools for customer service excellence.
methodology: The course employs a variety of methods including case studies, self-assessment exercises, application of service quality tools, video clips with debriefing sessions, as well as oral and written questions that spark debates. Brief presentations by both consultants and participants are also included.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Develop a comprehensive customer care approach by considering seven key aspects of customer service
Design objectives and programs to enhance internal customer satisfaction
Evaluate and analyze customer satisfaction surveys
Leverage customer complaints as opportunities for service improvement
Draft effective Service Level Agreements (SLAs) to ensure clarity and compliance
Assess the service aspect of their organization or department using well-chosen Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
